# Reader facts packs

The facts pack is everything the summary writer is allowed to know about a run. These are
frozen real ones, so the validator can be tested against the shape and the numbers a live
run actually produces rather than against a hand-built dictionary that happens to agree
with the checker.

| File | Run | How it was made | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oil_pack_2026-09-16.json` | `oil_dividend_v1`, 134 names, Magic Formula RAW + Forensic + Cyclical Income | `rebuild_pack.py` — replays the three frozen runs under `runs/` offline, so it is reproducible from this repo alone | `test_reader_check.py` (`PACK`) |
| `oil_pack_2026-09-17.json` | `oil_dividend_v1`, 134 names, Cyclical Income (primary) + Forensic + Magic Formula RAW | Captured from a live ranker-only run against the dated day cache on 2026-09-17, for SHORTLIST-2 / READER-4 | `test_reader_check.py` (`PACK_0917`) |

**The 09-17 pack is a RECORD, not a replay.** Its inputs were the day cache, which ages
out, so it cannot be regenerated byte-identically tomorrow — the committed JSON is the
artefact. That is deliberate and it is why it is committed rather than built: it is the
first pack carrying `role` on every test, `unanimous_buy`, and a kept shortlist row with
`price_warning_percentile`, and the v4 prompt's worked example was written from these
exact numbers. Re-deriving it from a later run would move those numbers and quietly
invalidate the example.

READER-5 kept both packs and both pins. What changed is what a failure MEANS: only four
checks withhold now (numbers, names, roles, unanimous BUYs), and the rest are recorded as
notes. `test_reader_check.py` reads these packs for both — the four live summaries of
2026-09-16/17 are checked against them, and only the one that misdescribed the run is
withheld.

The example is pinned against this pack two ways:
`test_the_v4_exemplar_PASSES_every_check` runs the validator on it, and
`test_the_exemplar_in_the_PROMPT_is_the_one_that_was_checked` asserts every sentence of
the checked text appears in `reader_v4.md` — so a verified example cannot drift from the
file that ships it.
